data.name: SolPlex: Dominion
data.detailed_description:
BUILD YOUR GALACTIC DOMINION

Enter the persistent galaxy of SolPlex Dominion, a large scale sci-fi strategy MMO where every decision shapes the future of your empire. Expand across multiple colonies, manage complex industrial production chains, forge powerful alliances and wage war against rival commanders in an ever evolving galactic battlefield.

Build your economy, command advanced military forces, compete in player driven markets and battle for dominance across a living MMO universe filled with conflict, progression and strategic warfare.

BUILD A GALACTIC INDUSTRIAL NETWORK

Begin with a single Synthetix Hub and expand into a vast network of specialised colonies. Construct basic resource facilities to fuel your economy, advanced conversion structures to refine higher tier materials and strategic buildings that unlock military, defensive and economic advantages.

Upgrade production chains, optimise colony efficiency and expand your infrastructure across multiple settlements as your empire grows in scale and complexity. From resource generation to strategic expansion, every building plays a critical role in powering your rise through the galaxy.

MASTER A COMPLEX GALACTIC ECONOMY

Manage a multi tier resource network designed to power every aspect of your empire. Produce essential Tier 1 resources, convert them into increasingly advanced materials and optimise production chains to support expansion, military growth and strategic progression.

Protect critical reserves through strategic infrastructure like the Hypernova Reserve, configure resource allocation based on your current objectives and carefully manage storage capacity across every colony. As your empire grows, balancing production, conversion, protection and storage becomes essential to sustaining a large scale galactic operation.

FORGE POWERFUL ALLIANCES

Survival in the galaxy is never guaranteed alone. Join forces with other commanders to defend your colonies, reinforce allies under attack, coordinate devastating joint assaults and support your faction through shared resources and strategic cooperation.

Alliances play a critical role at every stage of progression, from early game protection to large scale territorial warfare. As conflicts evolve across the server, strong coordination, diplomacy and teamwork become essential to securing power and surviving an increasingly dangerous galaxy.

TRADE, AUCTION AND CONTROL THE MARKET

Shape the galaxy through a fully player driven marketplace system. Buy and sell critical resources with other commanders, manage supply across your colonies and capitalise on shifting market demand as the server evolves.

Discover powerful Artefacts, ancient relics that provide strategic boosts capable of accelerating production, strengthening infrastructure and enhancing your empire’s progression. Trade rare finds through the auction system, secure valuable upgrades from other players or build your own collection to gain an advantage in an increasingly competitive galaxy.

ENTER A PERSISTENT MMO BATTLEFIELD

Compete in a living galaxy where every colony, alliance and battle can shape the balance of power across the server. Train multiple unit types, build specialised fleets and develop strategies designed for both large scale warfare and long term survival.

Engage in PvP combat against rival commanders, launch coordinated assaults with your alliance or challenge powerful ancient colonies scattered throughout the galaxy. From strategic raids to massive conflicts, every decision carries risk, reward and lasting consequences in an ever evolving MMO universe.

  • Storage: 1 GB available space
